Name: Machine Output Other to Artisan - Cornucopia More Crops
Author: Burstar
Description:
Based on [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/6480]6480[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38755]Produce Category Swapper[/url] (with their permission).

Items can be individually configured with the Generic Mod Config Menu.

Oddities:
Previously existing items using the old category will still exist and can be
'fixed' by splitting the stack and placing the old one onto the new.

I make no warranties as to the usefulness or safety of using this mod.  Use at your own risk.
